ARCH-003 resolved by budget correction (review fix): Pipeline.run measures 718 lines at 819bc92 by the rule's own measurement (def line to end_lineno) — SPEC's '702 post-stage-1' premise did not match, and the earlier 790 -> 710 ratchet left the real 718 site permanently baselined-open. Budget corrected 710 -> 718 (still a legal may-only-lower move from 790) and the entry (fingerprint dcf6f41a80e91fae) promoted open -> fixed_pending_review -> fixed with fixed_commit 819bc92 by this human PR. Protection mechanism: the violation text is `Pipeline.run:<N>` and fingerprint.normalize_text strips numeric literals, so growth keeps the SAME fingerprint — protection comes from the entry being FIXED: reappearance at the same site classifies TRUE_REGRESSION and fails the P3 gate (verified empirically: planted +3-line growth in an archive copy -> tracker TRUE_REGRESSION, exit 1). Growth that stays below budget never fires — that is the intended ratchet semantics (a may-only-lower budget, not a tripwire on every line).

budget ratchets (config/audit-rules.yaml kept in sync): pipeline_run_lines 790 -> 718 (measured reality at 819bc92; see the ARCH-003 note), env_getenv_sites 188 -> 191 (audited-repo reality post-Day-2; +3 = two ETHER_BATCH_COMMANDS gates + stage-1 loop flag, ADRs 0001/0002). env_getenv_sites actual is 200 including the pack self-scan (+9 pack getenv sites) vs the 191 audited-repo budget — QUAL-005 is warn-severity and never blocks; documented only.

violations resolved by Days 1-2 (SEC-001/002/003/004/005/008, MEAS-005 et al.) promoted fixed_pending_review -> fixed with fixed_commit 819bc92 by this human PR, so reappearance classifies as TRUE_REGRESSION (P3 gate).

stage-2 ratchet (migration/stage2-verification-spine): the verification spine (tool_scan/audit/critique/prompt_guard/holdout/reward, legacy pipeline.py:649-841) moved verbatim into Pipeline._verify_legacy and the ETHER_LOOP_RUNNER dispatcher, so Pipeline.run measures 572 lines by the rule's own metric (end_lineno - lineno). philosophy: Grandfathering: fingerprints recorded here as known/current do NOT block; NEW fingerprints block at blocker severity. Ratchet rules additionally compare counts/budgets and block increases. Baseline changes require human PR — the flywheel bot may never merge baseline updates (D-01).
